channel.name: Clover & Bruno Stories
channel.spine: Polite kitten Clover always with Mama Rosa + Papa Fin meets 70-year-old retired grumpy dog Bruno who never says yes first time, mostly with Pip — 70% both families together.
channel.tagline: Every day starts with Clover. Every legend starts grumpy.
channel.description:
Welcome to Clover & Bruno Stories — original photoreal stories about a cat and dog family living like humans on Paw Street.

Clover is a polite, gentle kitten who always comes with Mama Rosa and Papa Fin. Next door is Bruno, a 70-year-old retired dog — arrogant outside, soft inside, who never says yes in one attempt — mostly with his sidekick Pip.

70% of our stories bring both families together — polite Clover meets grumpy Bruno. 15% are Clover family only, 15% are Bruno & Co only.

Every episode is a complete slice of life — chores, small mistakes, wishes coming true, money troubles, trips, and kindness. Warm humor, dry wit, and an earned emotional turn.

AI-generated original stories. Not real footage. Photoreal anthropomorphic cat and dog family stories — Kitten Clover and Grumpy Dog Bruno.

Cat and dog stories weekly — Shorts and Longs.

brand_assets.scope_note: Avatar, banner, and signature mark are YouTube channel-display assets only. They are set once in Studio and never gate, block, or feed any episode-production stage (00-preflight through 07-final-package-qa) - unlike the CAST-001..007 character reference packs in characters/, which stage 04b onward do depend on.
brand_assets.banner_text_note: YouTube renders the channel name as its own UI text on the channel page regardless of the banner image, so title/tagline text baked into the banner art is decorative only, not load-bearing. It only needs to look right in the desktop/TV crop - it is not required to sit inside the mobile 'viewable on all devices' safe zone.

cast_system.bruno_never_yes_first_rule: Every Bruno appearance must have first answer = No with attitude, second = reluctant soft yes + helps
cast_system.co_appearance_defaults: Clover usually appears with at least one parent; Bruno usually appears with Pip. DEFAULTS, not laws (revised 2026-10-29, owner decision) - depart from them when the story is better for it, and declare the departure in the episode's cast snapshot. See CAST.md section 4.
